requirements.evidence: Research.forwardDifference_error_bound explicitly quantifies every f,D: R -> R and x,h,L: R, assumes all five source hypotheses, and concludes the full requested absolute error bound.

Research.forwardDifference explicitly returns (f(x+h)-f(x))/h, sampling the supplied f at x+h and x. This is an actual expression rather than abstract choice. Total division at h=0 does not affect the theorem for h>0.

requirements.evidence: Target hypotheses (3) and (4) require continuity on [x,x+h] and ordinary differentiability at every x<t<x+h with derivative equal to D(t). This is equivalent to having derivative D(t) on the open interval.

requirements.requirement: Use the pointwise absolute variation bound relative to D(x) on the open interval.
requirements.evidence: Target hypothesis (5) explicitly requires |D(t)-D(x)| <= L|t-x| for every x<t<x+h, using the supplied value D(x) as reference.
